content:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: p99 latency spike detected in router pool (eu-west-2). Multiple streaming stalls reported. Paging oncall.

alex: saw the alert, looking at dashboards now. p95 ~ 420ms -> 1.2s, p99 -> 3.8s on router-ingress in euw2.

maria: confirmed, traces show a sharp increase in tail after 13:02 UTC. Streaming connections show stalls/long polling timeouts.

jess: any customer-visible errors? CS flagged a couple of customers seeing slow responses on chat streams.

ops-bot: Telemetry snapshot: ingress-latency.p99:euw2=3.8s (+260%), streaming-stalls=east-region=124/min, unhealthy-shard-handbacks=47.

alex: initial hypothesis: routing policy weight shuffle earlier at 12:58 UTC pushed traffic to a small subset of shards -> hot partitions.

tomas: logs show a flurry of misroutes to shard-17/18 (hot keys). Router decision traces: policy_eval returned weight vector where euw2 local_prefer increased weight for hot_shard pool.

anjali: jumping in — can we temporarily force traffic away from those shards/zone? Suggest flip to weight-stable rollout (rollback last policy) and scale dedicated pool.

alex: trying a manual policy rollback now (rolling to config v2026-03-15-1200). Will push a route change that reduces weight to hot_shard pool.

jess: FYI customers impacted: acct-9012 (enterprise chat), acct-4432 (embedding ingest) reported latency spikes. CS is messaging mitigations.

oncall-bot: NOTE: paging escalation threshold met. paging to SRE-bridge.

maria: after policy rollback p95 dropped to 350ms within 60s, p99 slowly trending down but still high at 1.5s. Streaming stalls reduced but some sessions still hang.

alex: discovered a bug in the balancer: when weight vector includes very high skew for 'prefer_local', fallback logic sometimes leaves requests pinned to the same shard leading to cache-evaporation. File: router/policy_engine/weight_normalizer.go line ~212.

anjali: can we evict hot shard keys from cache or trigger KV cache reset? That might be heavy. Alternative: enable eager-fallback to fallback-tier for streaming requests to break affinity.

ops-bot: Executing: set routing.eager_fallback=true for streaming route in euw2 -> applied.

alex: enabling eager-fallback reduced stuck sessions by ~70% according to live metrics. p99 now ~900ms, still above SLO of 500ms.

tomas: there's a secondary issue: cross-region steering between euw2 and euw1 is asymmetric due to stale seed; some clients kept being routed in loop causing retransmits. I can trigger a routing-seed-sync.

maria: do it. also start a limited drain of shard-17/18 to redistribute state. We'll coordinate with Dedicated autoscaler to provide capacity while drain completes.

jess: notifying affected customers with ETA ~30m for full mitigation. Adding note to status page: "Investigating higher latency for EU region; limited customer impact on streaming".

ops-bot: scaling: +6 instances to dedicated-euw2 pool requested; request accepted, instances provisioning (ETA 4m).

alex: routing-seed-sync complete. Confirmed forwarding tables aligned across zones.

anjali: drain started for shard-17 (graceful, 120s). Will evacuate KV and let requests failover.

maria: once shards draining begins, watch connection churn; may spike briefly but should reduce tail.

(2m later)

ops-bot: Dedicated instances healthy; autoscaler finished.

alex: drain finished for shard-17; shard-18 at 60% now. p99 dropped to 520ms. streaming stalls nearly gone.

jess: CS update sent: customers seeing improved latency; some residuals.

maria: mitigation summary so far: 1) policy rollback, 2) eager-fallback enable for streaming, 3) seed sync, 4) shard drain + scale up. These collectively brought p99 from 3.8s -> ~500ms.

tomas: root cause appears to be a regression in weight_normalizer that amplified prefer_local skew when traffic delta > 40% and hit a rounding path that pinned shards. This exposed hot-key behavior.

alex: filing a bug: #INC-7892 weight_normalizer: rounding/pinning regression. Adding stack traces and router logs.

anjali: post-incident action items (brief):
- Roll the weight_normalizer fix and add unit tests for skew thresholds
- Add alert rule for shard hot-evictions/unbalanced-weight-change > 30% in 1m
- Improve streaming fallback test harness for sticky sessions
- Run chaos test with weight shuffles to ensure graceful degrade

jess: can we confirm customer-impact window for postmortem? Looks like 12:58 -> 13:20 UTC (22m), with major tail from 13:02 -> 13:10 (8m).

maria: agree. I'll start an incident page with timeline and link metrics/dashboards.

ops-bot: Reminder: oncall handoff incoming in 20m. alex — do you want to hand to maria or escalate to night oncall?

alex: handing to @maria for the next 30m to validate that p99 stabilizes < 500ms. I will own the remediation PR.

maria: taking handoff. I'll keep the bridge open, triage tasks assigned.

jess: tagging PM and risk/comms: @product, @legal (for enterprise notices).

(closure)

maria: marking incident as mitigated at 13:19 UTC. Will keep monitoring for 1h then transition to postmortem.

alex: adding logs and debug bundle to #INC-7892, attaching routing traces.

anjali: thanks all. We'll schedule a follow-up retro tomorrow.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. p99 returned to 430ms at 13:25 UTC.

jess: great job everyone :tada:

maria: assigning postmortem lead: alex. Owners for action items: alex (bugfix), anjali (alerts/tests), tomas (seed-sync automation), jess (customer comms).

end of thread
